data.name: Component
data.description: Data model representing a software component with name, file path, IO, description, and children.

data.name: Edge
data.description: Data model representing a directed edge between two components with a specified edge type.

data.name: ExternalActor
data.description: Data model representing an external system or service that the architecture interacts with.

data.name: ComponentIO
data.description: Data model representing the inputs and outputs of a component.

data.name: Cluster
data.description: Data model representing a cluster of components within a zone.

data.name: DiagramSpec
data.description: Data model representing the complete specification of a system diagram including components, edges, and external actors.

data.name: DiagramTemplate
data.description: Data model representing a diagram template with component tiers and edge types.

data.name: TracerRequest
data.description: Data model representing a tracer request containing repository blueprint information.

data.name: TemplateNode
data.description: Data model representing a node in a diagram template.

data.name: TemplateEdge
data.description: Data model representing an edge in a diagram template.

data.name: ZonePlan
data.description: Data model representing a zone plan in the repository blueprint.

data.name: ZoneClusterPlan
data.description: Data model representing a zone cluster plan in the diagram specification.

modules.name: layout_agent
modules.description: Agent responsible for determining optimal layout and clustering of architecture diagram components.
modules.purpose: Transforms diagram specifications into optimized layouts by classifying component archetypes, planning zones and clusters, selecting templates, and assigning component tiers and positions for visualization.

business.name: ClusterPlanner
business.description: Plans zone clusters for a module by computing component metrics, validating clusters, and falling back to role-based grouping if needed.

business.name: ComponentTypePlanner
business.description: Plans component types and ordering for a DiagramSpec by analyzing component names, counts, and relationships.

business.name: LayoutService
business.description: Orchestrates the layout pipeline for diagram generation. It first builds a module graph from the spec using ModuleGraphBuilder, then classifies component archetypes using ArchetypeClassifier, and finally assigns rank positions to components for visualization.

business.name: OwnershipResolver
business.description: Resolves component ownership and hierarchy within a diagram specification by computing metrics and determining parent-child relationships.

business.name: SemanticLayoutService
business.description: Applies semantic analysis to diagram layout by scoring component importance, validating semantic annotations, and assigning component tiers based on metrics.

business.name: ViewPlanner
business.description: Orchestrates view planning for diagram layout. It coordinates ComponentArchetypeClassifier, ComponentTypePlanner, and TemplatePlanner to determine the optimal diagram views and templates based on the specification.

business.name: _TemplateBuilder
business.description: Builds diagram templates from module graphs and specifications. It computes template depth and constructs template nodes and edges based on the diagram type and module structure.

business.name: _ViewBuilder
business.description: Builds diagram views for modules and components. It constructs template nodes and edges for both module-level and component-level views, applying archetype classification and ordering.

business.name: TemplateSelectorService
business.description: Selects appropriate diagram templates based on diagram type and specification. It uses ModuleGraphBuilder to construct the module graph and TemplateRegistry to retrieve template definitions.

business.name: TemplatePlanner
business.description: Plans diagram templates using an LLM-based approach. It coordinates with TemplateRegistry and SelectDiagramTemplateTool to determine the best template configuration for the given specification.

business.name: TemplateRegistry
business.description: Registry for diagram template definitions. It provides access to template configurations and their limits based on diagram type.

tools.name: ComponentMetricsBuilder
tools.description: Builds component metrics by computing fan-in and fan-out for each component in a DiagramSpec.

tools.name: ClusterValidator
tools.description: Validates raw cluster data against a Module by checking zone structure, cluster membership, and styling.

tools.name: ClusterFallback
tools.description: Groups components by role when cluster validation fails, producing a fallback ZoneClusterPlan.

tools.name: ArchetypeClassifier
tools.description: Classifies a ModuleGraph into an Archetype by analyzing its structure and returning both the archetype and a reasoning string.

tools.name: ComponentArchetypeClassifier
tools.description: Classifies a component's archetype by analyzing its callers, callees, and children relationships.

tools.name: ModuleGraphBuilder
tools.description: Builds a module dependency graph from a diagram specification by analyzing component-to-module mappings and entry points.

tools.name: ImportanceScorer
tools.description: Scores component importance based on metrics and assigns primary tiers to components.

tools.name: SemanticValidator
tools.description: Validates semantic properties of diagram components and modules, extracting tier and role annotations from raw data.

tools.name: SelectDiagramTemplateTool
tools.description: Selects an appropriate diagram template for a given specification by binding the spec and delegating to TemplateSelectorService.

config.name: TemplateLimitsConfig
config.description: Configuration for template limits and constraints.

business.name: BlueprintValidator
business.description: Validates a raw blueprint dictionary against a RepoSkeleton to produce a RepoBlueprint with validated modules and zones.

business.name: ModuleDetector
business.description: Detects module boundaries in a codebase by analyzing file paths for entry markers and package markers.

business.name: RepoMapService
business.description: Builds a repository skeleton by detecting modules and organizing them into a hierarchical directory structure.

business.name: ProfilerService

tools.name: GetFileTreeTool

business.name: EvidenceService
business.description: Builds evidence bundles by parsing file contents with AstService to extract signatures, imports, and call graphs.

business.name: AstService
business.description: Parses Python source files to extract class signatures, method definitions, imports, and HTTP calls using AST analysis.

business.name: GraphValidator
business.description: Validates a DiagramSpec against evidence by checking that all components and edges are properly defined and that call/http edges are backed by evidence.

business.name: CallGraphService

business.name: CorrectionPromptBuilder
business.description: Constructs a prompt for correcting validation errors based on a ValidationResult and attempt number.

The service processes tracer requests by invoking BuildCallGraphTool and BuildEvidenceTool, then validates the results with GraphValidator, applies corrections via CorrectionPromptBuilder, and finally assembles the specification with SpecAssembler.

meta.rationale: The system implements a strict sequential processing pipeline: repository profiling → code tracing → layout planning → rendering. Each stage transforms its input and passes output to the next. The api module orchestrates this flow but is not itself a pipeline stage. The varied zone structures and call-based edges confirm sequential processing rather than layered tiers or hub-and-spoke coordination.

This module has a single zone with one secondary component (AnswerSheet) that serves as a data container with no runtime edges or orchestration flow. The zoned structure is appropriate as it represents a self-contained data entity within the evaluation module.

This is a data-only module with no runtime edges or orchestration. All components are secondary-tier models representing different aspects of diagram and architecture specification. They naturally group by semantic role: core diagram entities (Component, Edge, ExternalActor), diagram specification structures (DiagramSpec, DiagramTemplate), template internals (TemplateNode, TemplateEdge), planning/request models (ZonePlan, ZoneClusterPlan, TracerRequest), and component metadata (ComponentIO, Cluster). A zoned layout with grid-style clusters best reflects this peer-based, role-driven organization.

The module follows a clear sequential flow from graph construction through classification to final layout assignment.

Single-zone module with one primary service component. No complex internal orchestration or sequential pipeline — PlacementService is a straightforward service that delegates to PlacementRegistry. Zoned layout preserves clarity for a simple, focused business logic unit.
